attributes.powers:
If you played a weapon that has the 2-Handed trait on this check, you may not play this card.

Recharge this card to reduce Combat damage dealt to you by 2, or by 3 if it is Ranged Combat damage. If you are proficient with light armors, you may play another armor on this check.
